# Prepared Hero

> > Prepared Hero provides fire safety products and emergency preparedness resources, featuring Hero Fire Spray, fire blankets, and personal safety devices alongside expert guidance on home protection and wilderness survival.

The site offers comprehensive fire safety education aligned with NFPA and FEMA standards, while selling innovative safety products including Hero Fire Spray, Hero Fire Blanket, Hero Defense Alarm, and survival gear. Content covers everything from kitchen fire prevention to wilderness preparedness, insurance claims, and emotional recovery after disasters.

## Key Topics

- Hero Fire Spray
- Fire Safety & Prevention
- NFPA (National Fire Protection Association)
- Emergency Preparedness
- Hero Fire Blanket
- Fire Extinguisher Types & Maintenance
- Grease Fire Safety
- Home Fire Safety
- FEMA (Federal Emergency Management Agency)
- Wilderness Survival
- Hero Defense Alarm
- Fire Insurance & Claims
- Electrical Fire Prevention
- Fire Evacuation Procedures
- Survival Gear & Kits
